verdict.rationale: The only product-level evidence of acting on many items at once is a homepage marketing anecdote that the CAO dispatched 50 agents across 500 open issues. That suggests agent-driven parallel processing of many items, but there are no docs describing how it works. The terminal's 'close all other sessions' action is only an adjacent convenience. Missing for 10: documented bulk-selection or batch-action features (multi-select edit/delete/move across topics, agents or tasks), documented batch API/CLI operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
